name: premium-seeds-film
description: Cinematic brand film for Premium Seeds (Bengaluru) built with Remotion.

scripts.studio: npm run prepare-assets && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render: npm run prepare-assets && remotion render src/index.ts PremiumSeedsFilm out/premium-seeds-16x9.mp4
scripts.render:vertical: npm run prepare-assets && remotion render src/index.ts PremiumSeedsFilmVertical out/premium-seeds-9x16.mp4
scripts.render:preview: npm run prepare-assets && remotion render src/index.ts PremiumSeedsFilm out/premium-seeds-preview-540p.mp4 --scale=0.5 --crf=26
scripts.render:guide: npm run prepare-assets && remotion render src/index.ts AssetGuide out/premium-seeds-asset-guide.mp4 --scale=0.5
scripts.render:all: npm run render && npm run render:vertical
